title: Ship Bites
description: Required design choice. The mechanism that lets a ship cut through or traverse the tangled waves. Multiple bites may be taken.

options.name: Sawprow
options.description: A chainsaw edge running down the curve of the prow, capable of cutting through most obstructions.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Serrated damage when ramming.

options.name: Impellers
options.description: Large jet-like outboard engines that push the ship through the waves with brute force.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Blast damage when ramming.

options.name: Crawler
options.description: Large finger-like mechanisms that spread around the front of the ship, letting it move with a crawling motion.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Blunt damage when ramming.

options.name: Underscales
options.description: Thousands of flexing scales that worm the ship forward with a sly, sinuous motion.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Keen damage when ramming.

options.name: Jag-Tracks
options.description: Motorised grapple tracks along the keel and hull-sides; a slow, solid, and reliable choice.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Hewing damage when ramming.

options.name: Sluicejets
options.description: Pressurised sluice systems filled with phytophobic chemicals, for coating the hull and pushing the ship.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Acid damage when ramming.

options.name: Longjaw
options.description: An underslung chainsaw arrangement that extends from the front of the ship, chewing and pulling forward.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Serrated damage when ramming.

options.name: Propeller-Cage
options.description: A cage housing that holds large airboat-style propellers used to push the ship forward.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Blunt damage when ramming.

options.name: Navapede Limbs
options.description: Centipedal limbs lining the hull, letting a ship scuttle through the thrash.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Spike damage when ramming.

options.name: Voltaic Runners
options.description: Crackling with barely contained lightning, these outboard contraptions let a ship float just above the churning branches.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Volt damage when ramming.

options.name: Mulcher
options.description: Grinding teeth in a lamprey-style mouth. Terribly noisy but dreadfully effective.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Serrated damage when ramming.

options.name: Tentaculari
options.description: A living cluster of tendrils or tentacles attached to the hull, carrying the ship in an unsettlingly alien motion.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Salt damage when ramming.

options.name: Square Sail
options.description: Taut canvas that relies on a strong breeze, harking back to an age of calm, clear waters.
options.special: Only effective in favourable winds.

options.name: Sleek Sail
options.description: Triangular and manually angled, relying on an attentive crew to catch the right breezes.
options.special: Only effective in favourable winds.

options.name: Sweat-Sails
options.description: Held low to the waves, unfurled canvases shaped to catch the rising under-canopy heat.
options.special: Only effective in warm weather.

options.name: Tethered Kites
options.description: An array of kites that catch the stronger winds of the lower air.
options.special: Only effective in favourable winds.

options.name: Gecko Sails
options.description: A reinforced multi-sail arrangement designed to tame even the wildest gusts.
options.special: Only effective in favourable winds.

options.name: Sharpened Prow
options.description: A honed blade running the length of the ship's prow to cut through vegetation. Provides a cutting edge but no motive force.
options.special: Deals massive CQ Keen damage... or it would, if you could get up enough speed. Works best paired with oars.

options.name: Beast-Reins
options.description: A leash or yoke arrangement allowing well-trained beasts to pull the ship like a chariot.
options.special: Decide what kind of beasts they hold. The beasts require care, feeding, and sleep.

options.name: Grappling Array
options.description: Prow-mounted grappling hooks fired out to catch branches, then laboriously wound back in for slow, inexorable progress.
options.special: A ship running solely on a grappling array cannot Forge Ahead during a journey. Deals massive LR Spike damage.
